name: SPA/RS decreasing across R > G > B

technical_body.pattern: SPA / RS estimated embedding rates decrease across channels in R > G > B order (e.g. R=52%, G=40%, B=26%)
technical_body.probable_technique: image-lsb (sequential, RGB, 1 bpc, starting at top of image)
technical_body.next_action: raw-bit dump of R interleaved 1bpc sequential; eyeball head as ASCII
technical_body.python_snippet:
from PIL import Image
raw = Image.open('in.png').convert('RGB').tobytes()
bits = [(raw[i] >> 0) & 1 for i in range(0, len(raw), 3)]
by = bytes(int(''.join(map(str, bits[i:i+8])), 2) for i in range(0, len(bits) - 7, 8))
print(by[:256])

notes: Classic sequential-embedding fingerprint. Payload consumed most of R, spilled into G, tapered off in B.

name: SPA/RS equal across R ≈ G ≈ B

technical_body.pattern: SPA / RS embedding rates roughly equal across all three channels
technical_body.probable_technique: image-lsb (interleaved or spread traversal); ~12-15% suggests 1bpc, ~25-35% suggests 2bpc or higher-nibble
technical_body.next_action: raw-bit dump of R,G,B interleaved 1bpc; if that's noise, try 2bpc

name: Two adjacent bit-planes flagged on same channel

technical_body.pattern: bit_0 AND bit_1 both suspicious on the same channel (or bit_0..bit_3 all suspicious)
technical_body.next_action: raw-bit dump at 2 bpc (or nibble-dump for 4 bpc)

name: Low entropy on a suspicious LSB plane

technical_body.pattern: bit-plane entropy on the suspicious plane is ~2-4
technical_body.probable_technique: raw structured content, almost certainly uncompressed ASCII text
technical_body.next_action: dump raw bits, decode as ASCII, print head

notes: English text is not high-entropy; this is the giveaway that whoever hid it didn't compress or encrypt.

name: High entropy on a suspicious LSB plane

technical_body.pattern: bit-plane entropy on the suspicious plane is ~7.9-8.0
technical_body.probable_technique: compressed or encrypted payload — ciphertext and gzip both look like uniform noise
technical_body.next_action: cannot recover without key or format; report technique + entropy, do not fabricate a plaintext

technical_body.pattern: every alpha byte's low bit is 1
technical_body.probable_technique: NOT a payload — either fully-opaque source image or a hider fingerprint
technical_body.next_action: note the fingerprint, move to RGB

technical_body.pattern: SPA screaming but RS quiet, or vice versa
technical_body.probable_technique: not naive LSB replacement — LSB matching, higher-bit-offset embed, or randomized traversal
technical_body.next_action: try LSB matching decoder; try spread/randomized traversals

name: F5 signature match on a PNG

technical_body.pattern: F5 detector matches on a PNG
technical_body.probable_technique: almost always a false positive — F5 is a JPEG DCT tool
technical_body.next_action: note as noise, do not chase unless corroborated by another signal

name: SPA/RS screaming + low entropy + visible discoloration

technical_body.pattern: very high SPA/RS AND low bit-plane entropy AND visible banding / discoloration
technical_body.probable_technique: raw uncompressed payload directly overwriting pixel values (not LSB — the payload IS the pixel bytes)
technical_body.next_action: dump pixels directly (Image.tobytes()), decode head as ASCII
